heroHeadline: Sovereignty Dispute Flares Over Anutin's Border Visit as Ceasefire Holds Uneasily
heroSubtitle: PM Anutin Charnvirakul's August 23 visit to the disputed Hill 500/An Seh area near Chong An Ma drew a formal Cambodian protest and calls for his arrest, which Anutin dismissed on August 27. More than a year after the May 2025 flashpoint, the December 27 joint ceasefire remains formally in place even as both sides trade sovereignty claims over contested sectors.
